name: Vinson Electric
old_description: We decided years ago that customer satisfaction will be our #1 priority, and we have built a successful business on that foundation principle. Dedicated to service and product knowledge, we are confident that our team will earn your business over and over again. Call us, send us an email, or stop by our location to see how Vinson Electric Supply Inc. can assist you with all of your electrical and lighting needs!
about:
Vinson Electric Supply Inc. operates from Russellville, Arkansas, serving the region as a local electrical supply house. The company presents itself as a long‑standing presence in the community, though a specific founding year is not disclosed in the available sources. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman‑owned status are not stated.

The business runs a stocked warehouse and showroom, carrying inventory for both commercial and residential electrical needs. It functions as a distributor and reseller of electrical products rather than a manufacturer, providing immediate access to materials from its Russellville location.

Customers include contractors, maintenance departments, and homeowners across the Russellville area who require electrical supplies for commercial and residential projects. The company emphasizes walk‑in service and same‑day pickup from its local stock.

The company states that customer satisfaction has been its guiding principle since its inception, positioning responsive service and product knowledge as its primary differentiators.
